question: Two main objectives: 'removal of poverty' (Garibi Hatao) and 'attainment of self-reliance' was proposed in the _________ Five year plan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main objective of the** Fifth Five year plan **was to remove poverty **(Garibi Hatao)** and attain **self-reliance.**
 
• The term **'Garibi Hatao'** was coined by former Prime Minister of India, **Indira Gandhi**, during the **1971 election campaign.**
 
• The **Fifth Five year plan** was implemented from **1974-1979 **and was focused on** agriculture, industry, and human resource development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seventh Five year plan** (1985-1990) was focused on **modernization of industries** and** improvement of technology.**
 
• **First Five year plan **(1951-1956) was focused on **agriculture and irrigation. **
 
• **Third Five year plan** (1961-1966) was focused on **agriculture, industry, and transportation.**
